_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): domain / website change (RDAP, DNS-over-HTTPS, Wayback)
claim: The registrar-of-record or nameservers for example.com in the Verisign RDAP record change between 2026-11-06T00:00:00Z and 2026-12-06T00:00:00Z.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show the Verisign RDAP nameserver set or registrar for example.com in the end snapshot differing from the start snapshot taken at the signing time?

custom_definitions: Compare two resolver snapshots (start at signing, end at deadline) field by field on the normalised, sorted nameserver list and registrar name; page content or TLS certificate changes do not count.
RDAP is authoritative for .com; DNS-over-HTTPS answers are corroboration only.
Round-trip changes (A to B to A) inside the window are invisible to two snapshots and are NOT detected: v2 until the keeper snapshots hourly.
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.
